title: [Decision]: Role of the People Leadership Team
body:

Chief of Staff to the CPO

Before the next operating-rhythm review.

CPO and People function leads.

title: [Decision]: Performance-cycle alignment
body:
### Owner

CPO

### Decision needed

Should Harbor use Meridian Group's performance management cycle as written, or add Harbor-specific instructions?

### Deadline

Before manager guidance is finalized.

### Options considered

Use the parent approach unchanged; adapt it with Harbor-specific instructions; keep a separate Harbor cycle.

### Recommendation

Adapt the parent approach if the parent program owner confirms which elements are required and which can vary.

### Who must be consulted

Meridian Group program owner and Harbor People Operations.

### Cost of delay

Manager guidance may be delayed or may not explain local differences.

### Known facts

The parent requirements and Harbor's local instructions have not yet been confirmed together.

title: [Decision]: AI-assisted People work
body:
### Owner

People Operations lead

### Decision needed

Should Harbor allow limited AI-assisted drafting for non-sensitive People materials while tool guidance is reviewed?

### Deadline

Before the next People Leadership Team review.

### Options considered

Allow bounded drafting with human review; pause all exploration; let each team choose its own approach.

### Recommendation

Allow bounded drafting only for non-sensitive materials. Do not use AI output to make or recommend an individual employee decision.

### Who must be consulted

Relevant Harbor technology and control partners need to confirm boundaries.

### Cost of delay

Teams may continue to have different assumptions about what is allowed.

### Known facts

The tool and information boundaries have not been confirmed for this proposed use.
